title: FoodieGo iOS+Android delivery app
summary: Native iOS + Android app with login, restaurant browsing, push notifications, Stripe checkout. Initial estimate: 12 weeks / 90,000 EUR.
outcome: Delivered 5 weeks late (+42% time, +38% cost). Push notification provider integration and App Store review delays were the main drivers.

title: Quanta fitness tracker mobile
summary: Cross-platform mobile app (React Native) for workout tracking with HealthKit/Google Fit sync. Initial estimate: 8 weeks / 55,000 EUR.
outcome: Delivered on time, +5% cost overrun for a late-scope Apple Watch companion.

title: Lumen B2B billing SaaS
summary: Multi-tenant SaaS for SMB invoicing with Stripe + email reminders + admin panel. Initial estimate: 14 weeks / 110,000 EUR.
outcome: Delivered 5 weeks late (+36% time, +38% cost). Multi-tenancy and webhook reliability work was systematically underestimated.

title: Helix HR dashboard SaaS
summary: Internal-facing HR dashboard with SSO, role-based access, payroll integration. Initial estimate: 10 weeks / 72,000 EUR.
outcome: Delivered on time and on budget.

title: Atlas warehouse inventory tool
summary: Internal app for a logistics company: real-time stock, reorder alerts, RBAC, CSV import-export. Initial estimate: 6 weeks / 38,000 EUR.
outcome: Delivered 2 weeks late (+33% time, +29% cost). AWS networking and SSO with the corporate IdP took longer than scoped.

title: Sigma ETL pipeline for analytics
summary: Batch ETL pulling from 6 sources (Stripe, HubSpot, Postgres replicas) into Snowflake with dbt models. Initial estimate: 9 weeks / 68,000 EUR.
outcome: Delivered 4 weeks late (+44% time, +40% cost). Data quality issues in upstream sources required custom reconciliation logic.
